summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for the Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa Simplified Complete Audio & TTS Flow:
- Reconciles canonical audio prompt registry (OP01-OP94) and introduces OP52b dedicated reference number read-back prompt ID.
- Upgrades recipient verification to pronounce full 10-digit telephone numbers digit-by-digit (OP21) instead of last-four digits.
- Implements slow reference number readback (OP52b) with 0.8x cadence, 400ms digit pauses, and prefix handling after OP53 (success) and OP54 (keep reference).
- Implements audio-concatenation synthesis engine for digits with fallback to neural TTS.
- Configures 60-second silence watchdog with OP67 (Please Respond) audio alert and strict zero-skip branching.
